permitted_learning_from_void_run: Transport/source-engineering only: unbounded current index-chart and delivery-price routes are unsafe for protected-period source work and must not be used in this gate.
forbidden_learning_from_void_run: using observed DVOL trade counts to change probe windows
using observed empty windows to choose replacement dates
opening any price, basis, convergence, return or PnL outcome

allowed_sources: bounded history.deribit.com public/get_last_trades_by_currency_and_time using only the four frozen 2023-2024 windows
exact get_instrument metadata lookup only for instruments discovered inside those bounded windows
authorized_remediation.index_source_note: Standalone DVOL-index or settlement-history coverage is not authorized or required to decide this trade-tape source-density gate. Any later study requiring a standalone DVOL series must pass a separate bounded source gate before Discovery.

governance: The remediation is transport/source-scope only. It may not alter the frozen source-density decision rules or rescue the gate based on the void run's observations.
